map.重心超限有什么危险？: Danger of CG out of limits?
map.重心过前限制俯仰操纵变重、起飞抬轮困难；过后限制纵向静不稳定、配平困难甚至失控。: CG too far forward makes pitch heavy and rotation hard; too far aft gives static longitudinal instability and trim difficulty even loss of control. The load sheet must compute the CG envelope; over-limit must not take off.
map.燃油消耗会让重心怎么变？: How does fuel burn shift CG?
map.燃油箱位置决定：中央油箱消耗使重心前移、翼油箱消耗使重心后移，飞行中重心在包线内: Tank position decides: center-tank burn moves CG forward, wing-tank burn aft; in flight CG drifts within the envelope, which has margin. This tool computes static loading CG.
